resources.string: Try the built-in Demo immediately, or configure a planner and import an on-device GGUF model in Planner Settings. Demo uses fixed examples; an on-device model is required for local chat.

Microphone access enables voice.input and, on supported devices, voice.on_device_stt. You can deny access and keep using typed commands and Demo. Permission alone does not guarantee an installed speech recognition service.

Offline voice unavailable. Live dictation requires an installed Android on-device recognition service and an offline language (Android 12+). Qwen handles text, not microphone audio. Open Voice input settings or use typed input.
